    Descent of the direct Boca dilation through a faithful representation #

    The centered moment formula puts a dense linear subspace in the closed range of the faithful representation. Continuity therefore puts the entire compressed dilation in that range. Matrix positivity is then reflected through the injective star representation, producing a completely positive map into the original target algebra.
